conclusion: AArch64 instruction translation works once the model is put into the execution state the kernel runs in: SCR_EL3.NS|RW (and HCR_EL2.RW) make arm_el_is_aa64() true. With Unicorn's default SCR_EL3=0/HCR_EL2=0 the walk takes the AArch32 branch, reads T0SZ & 7 = 2 and starts at L2, which is why the real T0SZ=26 tables looked untranslatable. The earlier "no fetch translation" reading was a harness initialisation error, not an engine limitation; the default-state failure stays as the negative control.
